## What problem does this change solve?

Describe the specific engineering problem, requirement or defect.

## What changed?

Summarize schematic, PCB, firmware, documentation or manufacturing changes. Include affected references, nets and coordinates where useful.

## Why is this justified?

Link or cite the relevant datasheet, application note, calculation, measurement or prior issue. Distinguish assumptions from verified facts.

## How was it verified?

Check all that apply and attach results where practical.

- [ ] KiCad schematic/ERC reviewed
- [ ] KiCad PCB/DRC reviewed
- [ ] Connectivity preserved
- [ ] Geometry / impedance / current / thermal calculations updated as applicable
- [ ] Footprint and polarity/orientation reviewed
- [ ] BOM impact reviewed
- [ ] Manufacturing impact reviewed
- [ ] Bench/prototype measurement performed
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Release impact

- [ ] No release-gate impact
- [ ] Resolves a release blocker
- [ ] Introduces a new blocker or open question
- [ ] Requires fabrication/prototype validation

## AI-assisted change disclosure

If AI-assisted CAD, scripting or analysis was used, state what the AI changed or proposed and what independent checks were performed. AI output is not treated as verification by itself.

## Source identity

Record the PCB/source hash or commit used for the change when applicable.
